prompt: How much was 1 euro in pesetas?
response: The conversion rate between euros and pesetas changed over time because Spain adopted the euro as its currency on January 1, 2002. Prior to this date, the peseta was the official currency of Spain. When the euro was introduced, the fixed conversion rate was set at 1 euro = 166.386 pesetas. This rate was used to convert all financial transactions and values from pesetas to euros during the transition period.
